description: STRE3AM, the Strategic Technology Roadmapping and Energy, Environmental, and Economic Analysis Model, is a Julia and JuMP optimisation tool from Argonne National Laboratory. It represents stocks of industrial production assets and chooses future technology and fuel pathways under demand, cost, emissions and market-share constraints. Users specify facilities or aggregated industrial sectors, technologies, fuels, operating and investment costs, and a planning horizon. Outputs are production, retirement, investment, fuel-use and emissions trajectories for that case. Geography can be a facility or national industry; temporal coverage follows the modelled years. The repository publishes open source under a BSD three-clause style licence, while dependencies retain their own licences. A limitation is that least-cost transition paths depend on future demand, technology availability and emissions constraints, all of which require explicit scenario evidence. STRE3AM supports manufacturing decarbonisation and industrial energy-infrastructure planning. The catalogue's model-messageix-framework is a separate economy-energy scenario tool. No industrial input case was downloaded.
